title: Private Suite & Entrance - South Nashville
description:
Private suite with private entrance and two designated parking spots. King size bed, twin day bed, private bath, wet bar, mini fridge and microwave.  Off-street parking in quiet residential neighborhood. Convenient to downtown Nashville (8 miles), Brentwood (3 miles), Franklin (10 miles), and airport. Walking distance to park with hiking trails. Perfect for your visit to Nashville and surrounding area.

The guest suite is attached to my home, it is not a separate building or the entire house.

The space
Enjoy the master suite of my ranch home. You will have exclusive use of a spacious bedroom (200 sq. ft) and private bathroom with large shower and sky light.  Private entrance and deck. Small wet bar has microwave, fridge, sink, and dishes/glasses/cutlery. 
Coffee & tea provided.
There is no cable tv, only local network. There is a smart tv in the room with Roku, Netflix, and other streaming channels.

Guest access
No shared space.

Other things to note
Minutes from the interstate, airport, and downtown.  This is a quiet, residential neighborhood. It is not suited for parties or large groups. Please keep noise to a minimum as you come and go out of respect for my neighbors.
